definitions: Strangely unconventional; highly unusual and different from common experience, often in an extravagant, fantastic, and/or conspicuous way.

Any of several types of flower with stripes of various colours.
A carnation having stripes of two distinct colours on the white petals.
A tulip with a certain pattern of various colored stripes.
A carnation having stripes of two distinct colours on the white petals.

blocks.text: Bizarre is a Canadian sketch comedy television series that aired from 1980 to 1986. Hosted by John Byner, the series was produced by CTV at the CFTO's Glen Warren Studios in Scarborough, Ontario. It was initially broadcast in Canada on CTV and in the United States on Showtime.

Bizarre was a British alternative magazine launched by Fiona Jerome in 1997 and was published from 1997 to 2015. It was originally published by John Brown Publishing, but after IFG collapsed Dennis Publishing took over Publication. Bizzare was a sister publication to Fortean Times.
Rufus Johnson, better known by his stage name Bizarre, is an American rapper, best known as a member of the Detroit-based hip-hop group D12.
